Our work is set in a future where humanity has entered the early stages of an interstellar civilization. By constructing a virtual scenario of multi-planetary cultures and linguistic ecologies, it explores how language evolves through space migration, shaping new forms of identity and cultural boundaries.

[1]

[2]

LUNA, MARS, and NEPTUNE represent different stages of humanity’s exploration of space: the Moon marks the starting point, Mars represents one of the planets most comparable to Earth and a realistic target for future exploration, while Neptune symbolizes the distant frontier of human exploration into the outer Solar System.
